Six people run desperately up the street toward the camera. 4-9s: One man trips and falls on the road; right in front of him the cloud snaps a power pole and it crashes across the street in a burst of sparks, and he scrambles up and keeps running. 9-15s: Right below the terrace the cloud tears the roof tiles off the nearest house and hurls them toward the camera, then engulfs the camera in darkness. Handheld footage shot by a person standing on a hillside terrace above the village, high vantage looking down over the village street toward the erupting volcano; slight hand shake, the camera stays fixed on the terrace, tilting down no more than slightly and never descending, the erupting volcano always visible in the upper third of the frame, a corner of the terrace railing in the foreground; one continuous shot, no zoom, no cuts. Bystanders wear civilian clothes, no hi-vis PPE; responders wear service uniforms. Raw natural light under an ash-grey sky, never glossy or CGI; no hazmat suits. No readable signs, text or flags.
